name: Fermented-fish hotpot
summary: Lẩu mắm is the hotpot on the Cồn Phụng lunch. A town pot starts with pork bone and fermented cá linh, then basa, goby, pork belly, shrimp, squid, beef balls, eggplant, and bitter melon.
origin: On the Cồn Phụng lunch list, and in town on the provincial tourism portal.
howToEat: At Cồn Phụng it is a shared lunch pot. The rural article stops at the name.
where: The garden table at Cồn Phụng, and a town pot. Hours: Check on arrival.
